6f0abcabdbb11eac.description: About the Role Envisions Employment Solutions is seeking an AI/ML Engineer for one of its partners, an IT Services and IT Consulting company. This full-time role involves designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise AI and machine learning solutions across a program that manages multiple use cases concurrently. The work focuses on conversational assistants, retrieval and grounding, analytical capabilities, agent workflows, and validation controls to ensure accuracy and trustworthiness of responses. Key Responsibilities Build AI assistants to support parallel use cases within the program. Implement conversational querying, retrieval, grounding, evidence presentation, and agent orchestration. Integrate AI components with approved enterprise data platforms, APIs, and knowledge sources. Develop controls to validate generated answers and minimize unsupported responses. Contribute to shared AI platform components and reusable services. Support testing, benchmarking, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), controlled deployment, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer. Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, architects, and business subject matter experts. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 years of experience in hands-on delivery of generative AI, machine learning, or conversational AI solutions. Strong proficiency in Python, along with experience in APIs, structured data, retrieval techniques, and model evaluation. Experience with Azure AI and data services, or equivalent enterprise platforms. Understanding of security, access control, logging, monitoring, and responsible AI requirements. Preferred Skills and Technologies Experience with Databricks, ADLS, Azure AI services, or Azure AI Foundry. Proficiency in natural language querying over structured data. Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), agent orchestration, evidence binding, and LLM (Large Language Model) evaluation. Experience in the production deployment of enterprise AI solutions. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

6f1fde9a130920ec.description: About the Role Qiddiya | القدية is seeking an Analyst Transportation Operations to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on maintaining efficient and compliant transportation operations. The role involves monitoring fleet performance, managing maintenance data, and coordinating with various stakeholders to ensure operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain maintenance Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, inspection standards, and quality-control procedures. Monitor fleet and workshop performance Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including fleet availability, preventive maintenance compliance, repeat repairs, breakdowns, and workshop utilization. Maintain accurate and up-to-date fleet maintenance data and records, covering mileage, maintenance history, breakdowns, repair costs, and supporting documentation. Validate and process maintenance and supplier invoices against approved work orders, contractual rates, and completed services, resolving discrepancies and tracking approvals and payments. Monitor maintenance vendor performance against contractual KPIs such as turnaround time, repair quality, response time, and cost performance. Analyze breakdowns, recurring failures, accidents, and maintenance trends, conduct root-cause analysis, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate vehicle inspections to ensure compliance with company safety requirements and applicable regulatory standards before vehicles return to service. Prepare monthly dashboards and management reports on Pool Vehicle reservation, availability, maintenance costs, vendor performance, key risks, and improvement actions. Coordinate with stakeholders to prioritize repairs and maintenance activities based on operational requirements, vehicle availability, and service criticality. Ensure maintenance records and supporting documentation are accurate, audit-ready, and compliant with internal policies and contractual requirements. Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and relevant stakeholders to resolve invoice and payment issues and ensure timely closure. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Skills and Experience Strong Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI, particularly for maintenance dashboards and cost analysis. Good understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, vehicle lifecycle, and maintenance cost analysis. Experience working with workshops, dealerships, leasing companies, and spare-parts suppliers. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and provide practical recommendations. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

6f668ca66b1ab6e8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث طوارئيات للعناية الطبية عن كاتب حفظ ملفات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنظيم وتصنيف وحفظ المراسلات والوثائق المختلفة بطريقة منهجية لضمان سهولة الوصول إليها واسترجاعها عند الحاجة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فحص وفرز الكتب والمراسلات والإيصالات والفواتير والرسوم والبيانات وغيرها من الأوراق والوثائق المراد حفظها، وتصنيفها حسب النوع والطبيعة. تصنيف المكاتبات والمراسلات بناءً على الموضوع أو الحروف الهجائية أو أي نظام تصنيف معتمد آخر. وضع المواد المراد حفظها في الملفات المخصصة لها وفقًا للتصنيف المعتمد، وترتيب الملفات على الرفوف أو داخل الدواليب. استخراج الوثائق المحفوظة وتحويلها إلى الجهات المعنية عند الطلب ووفقًا للتعليمات المحددة. الاحتفاظ بفهارس أو بطاقات فهرسة الملفات بطريقة منظمة، والمحافظة على سلامة هذه الفهارس والملفات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال حفظ الملفات أو إدارة الوثائق. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية ودقة في التفاصيل. القدرة على اتباع أنظمة التصنيف والحفظ بدقة. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع طلبات استخراج الوثائق. بيئة العمل تلتزم طوارئيات للعناية الطبية بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة وشاملة. تتوفر لدينا بيئة ملائمة لذوي الهمم لضمان تكافؤ الفرص للجميع. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا ككاتب حفظ ملفات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

6f69c63971120708.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel Company Limited is seeking an Inventory Controller to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to managing daily sold vehicle requests and addressing inquiries from the sales team, ensuring smooth logistical support for frontline sales operations. Role Context and Impact The Inventory Controller plays a crucial supportive role in ensuring comprehensive logistical support for regional frontline sales. This position directly impacts the efficient management of daily sold vehicle requests and requires advanced knowledge in supply chain and sales channels. The role also involves a significant responsibility in adhering to IMTITHAL standards. Key Responsibilities Manage all early morning emails and key tasks related to the regional stockyard to achieve set KPIs, securing cross-functional support for stockyard operations. Ensure alignment of all work with supervisors (Arrival & Dispatch) operations to meet objectives in line with center expectations (retail, Lexus). Maintain close communication with the Regional Sales Team to provide complete logistical support from regional stockyards to frontline sales. Monitor closely with the KAIC department to ensure timely dispatch of vehicles. Oversee frozen/damaged vehicles and control stock and dispatching processes according to company policy. Ensure compliance with IMTITHAL standards related to the workplace and implement necessary corrective measures for outstanding points identified in audit reports. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Advanced knowledge in supply chain and sales channels is required. Decision-Making Authority The Inventory Controller has the autonomy to align on arrival and dispatch operations for both retail and Lexus segments, contributing directly to operational efficiency. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6fa26ca250b8a617.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق ديار الهدى الفندقية عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بمحاسبة التكاليف وحفظها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط ودراسة الأساليب المستخدمة في حساب التكلفة وتحديد عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة وحساب التكلفة الإجمالية. تحليل عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة بشكل دوري، وتحديد معدل التكلفة المعيارية، وتحديد الانحرافات ومساهمة كل منها في زيادة أو تقليل التكلفة. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالتكاليف وطرق التسعير، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة للإدارة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات حساب التكاليف ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في مجال المحاسبة وحساب التكلفة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بحساب التكاليف، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال محاسبة التكاليف. فهم عميق لمبادئ وأساليب حساب التكلفة وتحليلها. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية والتحليلية بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على تحديد الانحرافات. إتقان استخدام برامج المحاسبة والأدوات التحليلية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم التقارير والتوصيات للإدارة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتكيف مع بيئة عمل ديناميكية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل محاسب التكاليف ضمن فريق مالي متخصص في فندق ديار الهدى الفندقية، ويسهم في تعزيز الكفاءة التشغيلية من خلال إدارة التكاليف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في المدينة المنورة.

6fa279a4e2c16df4.job_title: Fashion Consultant Michael Kors Mall of Arabia
6fa279a4e2c16df4.description: About the Role Chalhoub Group is seeking a Fashion Consultant for Michael Kors at Mall of Arabia. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah, and requires 2-5 years of experience. The Fashion Consultant is responsible for achieving sales targets and ensuring an exceptional guest experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to drive individual and collective sales while maintaining high standards of guest satisfaction. The consultant will also support in-store customer and people initiatives, including CRM and CX programs, to enhance the overall retail experience. Key Responsibilities Achieve individual and collective sales targets. Deliver an exceptional guest experience. Support the implementation of CRM, CX, and other customer and people initiatives in-store. Collect data on customer behavior, top sellers, and slow-moving items for business reviews. Drive client relationships through an omni-channel approach. Provide pre-buying feedback on products. Drive eNPS through people experience initiatives and culture. Ensure adherence to Visual Merchandising (VM) guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Ensure click and collect services are conducted within Service-Level Agreements (SLAs). Ensure customer data is properly captured according to marketing team requirements. Promote the MUSE loyalty program and stay updated on app offerings. Support in-store marketing events and activations. Keep abreast of all brand social media activities and campaigns. Drive sell-throughs within the store. Support in-store CX initiatives. Provide input on store performance, highlighting successes and areas for improvement. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 years of experience in Retail, with a preference for fashion retail. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Makkah, with opportunities in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a retail setting, focusing on customer interaction and sales performance for the Michael Kors brand. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to the sales and customer experience objectives of Michael Kors within Chalhoub Group.

6fa54b79d3f9cd25.description: About the Role Business Management Company (BMC) is seeking a Network Operations Center (NOC) Team Leader to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires a senior technical leader to oversee NOC execution, ensuring disciplined monitoring, troubleshooting, and escalation within a complex telecommunications environment. Role Overview The NOC Team Leader will be responsible for guiding front-office and technical operations personnel. The role focuses on maintaining network availability, resolving incidents efficiently, and coordinating with various internal and external teams to address complex faults and drive continuous operational improvements. Key Responsibilities Lead front-office and technical operations personnel in monitoring network availability and resolving incidents. Review alarm handling, ticket quality, escalation accuracy, and restoration progress. Coordinate with back-office engineers, field teams, and equipment vendors during complex fault resolution. Maintain operational procedures, escalation matrices, and technical knowledge articles. Review recurring incidents and drive improvements in detection, diagnosis, and restoration processes. Coach engineers and assess technical readiness and operational performance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in network operations or a similar technical leadership role. Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams in a telecommunications environment. Strong understanding of network monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management processes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the successful candidate will work within a dynamic NOC environment, collaborating with various technical teams and external partners. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6ff5896f7f764119.description: About MoneyGram MoneyGram is a global payments network facilitating cross-border money movement with speed, simplicity, and trust. The company's omnichannel platform enables consumers, developers, and agents to transfer cash, fiat, and stablecoin. Serving over 60 million customers annually across more than 200 countries and territories, MoneyGram operates through nearly half a million retail locations and a growing digital ecosystem. Role Overview MoneyGram is seeking a Senior Regional Commercial Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for supporting the development and execution of the overall business development, marketing, and operations strategy within an assigned territory. This includes new sales across independent and small chain retail storefronts, banks, FinTechs, and aggregators. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage the P&L, focusing on maximizing market penetration and profitable transaction volumes. Oversee the ongoing maintenance of key accounts or super-agents to ensure profitable transaction growth and achieve set targets for the territory. Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of MoneyGram products and services, as well as competitor offerings, to educate business owners and decision-makers. Analyze trends and changes in transaction levels to identify and capitalize on growth opportunities. Generate leads and engage prospects to drive strategic new business signings, facilitating contractual arrangements on appropriate commercial terms. Ensure timely and efficient setup/roll-out of new networks, enhance brand visibility, and resolve operational issues through liaison with relevant teams. Plan and engage corridors with product strategies to drive volume growth, coordinating with corridor, pricing, and marketing teams. Maintain an up-to-date database to document sales call information, trends, future call objectives, sampling data, and overall sales performance. Participate in regional events to raise product and brand awareness with key business partners. Complete routine reports accurately and ensure compliance with regulatory and company guidelines. Required Experience and Skills A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Ability to professionally promote MoneyGram products to new and existing networks. Proficiency in monitoring competition and emerging market trends. Strong coordination skills to work effectively with territory partners in a team environment. Demonstrated capability to achieve sales growth targets. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working in a collaborative environment focused on achieving sales growth and market penetration within the assigned territory. Application Process MoneyGram is seeking professionals who thrive in collaborative environments and are energized by solving complex challenges. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

6f8cb523f405f4d3.company_name: شركة اتحاد ميار للخدمات الضيافه الفاخره
6f8cb523f405f4d3.description: نبحث عن مساعد شيف حلويات مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في ابتكار أشهى الحلويات. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تحضير المكونات، والمساعدة في إعداد وصفات الحلويات المتنوعة، وضمان جودة المنتجات النهائية. إذا كنت شغوفًا بفن صناعة الحلويات وتمتلك مهارات تنظيمية قوية، فإن هذه الفرصة مثالية لك. المهام والمسؤوليات: * المساعدة في تحضير وتجهيز جميع مكونات الحلويات حسب الوصفات المعتمدة. * تنفيذ مهام إعداد الحلويات تحت إشراف الشيف الرئيسي، بما في ذلك الخلط، الخبز، والتزيين. * الحفاظ على معايير عالية من النظافة والترتيب في منطقة العمل والمعدات. * المساهمة في تطوير وصفات جديدة واقتراح تحسينات على الوصفات الحالية. * التأكد من جودة المكونات المستخدمة والمنتجات النهائية المقدمة.

6f2cef458a9b5f80.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Sales Executive - Calibration Equipment & Services to join our team. This full-time position requires a professional with 2-5 years of direct experience in calibration sales within the Saudi market, specifically in Dammam, Al Khobar, or Riyadh. The role focuses on developing client relationships and driving sales of calibration services and related technical solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain relationships with existing and potential clients for calibration services. Identify new business opportunities and generate leads within the industrial and Oil & Gas sectors. Promote and sell calibration, instrumentation, electrical testing, and related technical services. Conduct client visits to understand customer technical and commercial requirements. Prepare and follow up on RFQs, quotations, tenders, and commercial proposals. Coordinate with technical teams to provide suitable calibration solutions to clients. Follow up with clients from initial inquiry through quotation, PO/order completion, invoicing, and payment collection. Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Monitor market trends, customer requirements, and competitor activities. Maintain an updated client database, sales pipeline, revenue reports, and sales forecasts. Identify potential subcontractors and suppliers when required for service execution. Build long-term business relationships and actively develop new accounts. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 2 years of direct experience in calibration sales. Candidates with only general industrial sales experience will not be considered. Current location or relevant market experience in Dammam, Al Khobar, or Riyadh. Experience dealing with industrial clients, preferably within Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Manufacturing, or related sectors. Good understanding of calibration services and related technical requirements. Proven ability to generate leads, develop clients, prepare quotations, and close sales. Strong communication, negotiation, and client relationship management skills. Valid Saudi driving license is preferred. Work Environment This role operates within the industrial and Oil & Gas sectors across Dammam, Al Khobar, and Riyadh, requiring regular client visits and engagement with technical teams. The position is full-time.

6f7b258d2db4b266.description: About the Role HCLTech is seeking a Senior Administrator - Change Management, ServiceNow to manage and govern IT infrastructure changes. This full-time role focuses on ensuring that all changes across production and non-production environments are properly documented, assessed, authorized, and implemented with minimal risk. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Review and challenge the risk and impact classification submitted by change owners. Assess potential impact to production services, applications, infrastructure, and dependent technology components. Identify cross-technology and cross-application dependencies. Ensure high-risk and business-critical changes receive appropriate technical and management review. Validate that adequate implementation, testing, and rollback provisions are available before progressing a change. Identify overlapping or potentially conflicting changes. Escalate unacceptable or inadequately mitigated risks to the appropriate Change Management or Service Management authority. Change Advisory Board (CAB) Coordination Coordinate and support Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings. Review changes for CAB readiness before presentation. Prepare CAB agenda and required change information. Coordinate with change owners and technical SMEs for clarification of risks, dependencies, impact, and implementation requirements. Present or facilitate discussion of changes requiring CAB review. Record CAB decisions, actions, observations, and conditions. Track conditional approvals and associated actions through closure. Follow up on rejected or deferred changes. Ensure CAB decisions are accurately reflected in the ITSM system. Support Emergency CAB / expedited governance for qualifying urgent changes. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in change management or a related IT service management role. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply.

6f825bbd6f19414b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديار الزائرين الفندقية عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير تجربة استقبال ممتازة للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة الاتصالات الواردة والصادرة بكفاءة، وتنظيم المواعيد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتقديم المعلومات المطلوبة لهم. إبلاغ الموظف أو القسم المعني بوصول الزوار والعملاء، وتوجيههم إليهم. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الجهة المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية اللازمة للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء الزوار والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، وتعتبر الوظيفة بدوام كامل. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق يسعى لتقديم أفضل الخدمات الفندقية للزوار. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

6fbe68c03b37f295.description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager with a strong background in the IT industry to oversee the successful delivery of technology projects and services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end project delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to agreed quality standards, while maintaining strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Oversee the end-to-end delivery of IT projects, ensuring timely and successful execution. Develop and manage delivery plans, project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation. Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams, including software developers, QA engineers, business analysts, and technical teams. Ensure projects are delivered according to scope, quality standards, and client expectations. Manage client relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for delivery-related matters. Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and implement mitigation plans. Track delivery KPIs, project performance, resource utilization, and team productivity. Manage project escalations and resolve delivery-related issues effectively. Collaborate with Sales, Presales, Product, and Technical teams to ensure smooth project execution. Ensure adherence to Agile/Scrum methodologies and project management best practices. Prepare and present regular project status reports to senior management and stakeholders. Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality and profitability. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in the IT industry, with at least 3–5 years in a Delivery Manager or similar leadership role. Proven experience managing end-to-end delivery of IT projects, software development projects, or technology solutions. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Solid experience with Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies. Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams. Strong knowledge of project planning, budgeting, resource management, and risk management. Excellent stakeholder and client management skills. Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

6fdcc7d5dab89903.description: About Master Works and Nabeh Master Works, through its subsidiary Nabeh, delivers AI-powered solutions designed to automate operations, enhance efficiency, and drive innovation for organizations. Nabeh specializes in areas such as computer vision, LLM applications, speech-to-text technology, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions. The Role of AI Product Manager Nabeh is seeking an AI Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and growth of AI-powered products. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves translating business and customer needs into scalable solutions using technologies such as Generative AI, LLMs, computer vision, and AI agents. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Own the product lifecycle from discovery and ideation through MVP, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. Define product vision, roadmaps, positioning, and measurable business objectives. Translate customer needs and market opportunities into product requirements and prioritized backlogs. Develop product strategies for B2B and enterprise AI solutions, identifying opportunities to transform customer-specific AI use cases into reusable product capabilities. Collaborate with engineering teams to define features powered by LLMs, VLMs, RAG, computer vision, and autonomous AI agents. Evaluate AI capabilities based on feasibility, model accuracy, latency, operating cost, and business impact. Define acceptance criteria, evaluation metrics, and quality standards for AI-driven features. Understand the trade-offs between hosted AI models, local deployment, and hybrid architectures. Prepare PRDs, user stories, wireframes, acceptance criteria, and release plans. Work with UI/UX designers to deliver intuitive experiences for technically complex AI products. Coordinate product releases, demonstrations, UAT, and go-to-market readiness. Define KPIs for adoption, retention, feature usage, model quality, and commercial performance. Work with business development and presales teams to support product demonstrations and technical positioning. Analyze competing AI products, market trends, and customer requirements. Support product pricing, packaging, licensing, and commercialization strategies. Ensure products address enterprise security, privacy, and Saudi regulatory expectations. Required Qualifications 4+ years of product management experience, including AI-enabled or enterprise software products. Strong knowledge of Agile product development, backlog management, and product discovery. Practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, APIs, and AI integration patterns. 6fbf2fa473d78f4b.job_title: SAP Integration Consultant (SAP CPI)-Immediate Joining (3 Month)
6fbf2fa473d78f4b.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced SAP Integration Consultant with 6–8 years of experience to join an onsite team in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia , supporting an MRO Inventory Optimization project for a leading petrochemical client. Due to client security policies, the role requires onsite presence. The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on experience in SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) / SAP Integration Suite , with expertise in designing, developing, and deploying real-time integrations between SAP and external applications. The consultant will be responsible for defining integration architecture, building and deploying CPI integration flows, and supporting cybersecurity approvals and solution rollout across multiple plants. Key Responsibilities Define and document the overall integration strategy, architecture, and API approach for the solution. Design and document end-to-end integration architecture and detailed data flows between SAP and external systems. Analyze business and technical requirements to identify the most appropriate integration mechanisms. Build, configure, test, and deploy real-time integrations using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) / SAP Integration Suite . Develop and maintain integration flows for SAP Material Master and Inventory (MM) data . Design and implement integrations using OData, IDoc, BAPI, RFC, REST, and SOAP APIs . Assess and confirm whether custom developments or enhancements are required. Collaborate closely with business, functional, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration delivery. Support client cybersecurity review and approval processes, ensuring secure integration design and implementation. Estimate CPI message volumes, throughput requirements, and associated runtime costs. Perform integration testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. Implement monitoring, logging, and error-handling mechanisms to ensure reliable operations. Support deployment and rollout from the initial pilot plant to additional plants across the organization. Prepare technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and deployment guides. Technical Requirements Must-Have Skills 6–8 years of experience in SAP Integration and Middleware technologies. Strong hands-on experience with: SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) / SAP Integration Suite Development and deployment of CPI integration flows SAP Material Master and Inventory (MM) data integration OData, IDoc, BAPI, RFC REST and SOAP APIs Integration architecture and data flow design Proven experience in designing and implementing real-time SAP integrations. Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and middleware architecture. Experience in technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and integration specifications. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration scenarios. Experience with secure connectivity mechanisms, including: SAP Cloud Connector OAuth Certificates and secure communication protocols Experience supporting cybersecurity reviews and security compliance processes. Familiarity with API Management capabilities. Experience in message monitoring, logging, exception handling, and operational support. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite certifications are highly desirable. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, oil & gas, or petrochemical environments is an advantage.

6f13786c45e58182.description: Role Summary The Quality Inspector – Mechanical is responsible for ensuring that all mechanical works—including HVAC, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, and mechanical equipment installations—are executed in full compliance with approved drawings, specifications, ITPs, and project quality procedures. The role involves daily site inspections, reviewing material and work inspection requests, and coordinating with engineers and contractors to maintain the highest standards of mechanical quality and safety on-site. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily inspections to ensure mechanical works follow approved ITPs, checklists, and project requirements. Proactively identify deficiencies, non-compliance, or faults in mechanical installations and report them immediately to the QC Manager for corrective actions. Close all WIRs (Work Inspection Requests) and MIRs (Material Inspection Requests) after obtaining proper signatures and ensuring supporting documentation is complete. Thoroughly review project specifications, mechanical drawings, PQP, ITPs, method statements, QC procedures, and related quality documents. Witness and document testing of mechanical systems (e.g., pressure tests, leakage tests, functional testing) and complete relevant forms. Monitor contractor practices related to mechanical quality control and safety compliance. Conduct daily meetings with the contractor's QC representative to ensure alignment with mechanical quality management procedures. Assist the construction team in resolving mechanical quality issues and technical challenges. Support the Quality Manager (QM) in preparing and conducting mechanical-related quality audits. Prepare daily QC reports and submit them to the QC Manager no later than 9:00 AM the following day. Verify that all mechanical testing tools and devices have valid calibration certificates. Review and maintain logs of WIRs, MIRs, MARs, NCRs, and other mechanical quality documentation. Highlight and report any mechanical miscoordination issues between disciplines to the Resident Engineer (RE) and Quality Manager (QM). Qualifications & Requirements 5–10 years of mechanical inspection experience, preferably in a PMC (Project Management Consultancy) environment. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline. Strong understanding of HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, mechanical utilities, and equipment installation. Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, specifications, and method statements. Solid knowledge of international mechanical codes and standards. Strong documentation, reporting, and communication skills. Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of resolving technical issues efficiently.

This role demands a high level of expertise in the design, execution, testing, and commissioning of complex mechanical systems. The ideal candidate will ensure stringent adherence to design criteria, codes, and industry standards at every stage of the project life cycle. Key Responsibilities Perform design reviews of design packages, providing constructability insights as needed to the Design & Engineering team or consultants. Review and coordinate shop drawings, and as-built drawings across multiple trades and disciplines. Supervise and inspect mechanical work, providing day-to-day monitoring of project progress within the project scope. Perform QA/QC inspections to identify nonconforming work, issuing periodic reports to track quality metrics. Respond to contractor requests for inspections, technical queries, and site clarifications, coordinating with the project management team to issue field directives as necessary. Verify quantities and work progress to ensure accuracy in completed work calculations. Coordinate and resolve mechanical design issues that arise during construction, working closely with all stakeholders, including contractors, to ensure alignment within the project scope. Support technical decision-making on mechanical systems, providing expertise to address design or installation challenges. Assist in the installation, troubleshooting, and repair of mechanical systems as needed. Offer technical knowledge and guidance on the operation of mechanical distribution systems. Lead commissioning, startup, and adjustments of mechanical systems and components, ensuring proper function. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Minimum of 8 years of experience in verifying design against construction, QA/QC, material specification, Mechanical Systems commissioning mainly residential HVAC and plumbing systems. Proficiency in engineering design tools such as SolidWorks and AutoCAD. Experience in site supervision, QA/QC inspections, and material installation. Strong experience in residential HVAC and plumbing systems. Knowledge of mechanical codes, standards, and commissioning processes. Ability to review mechanical designs and verify them against site execution. A team player with a strong aptitude for problem-solving. Ability to thrive in high-pressure environments and adapt to changing project needs. Willingness to travel to various project sites as required.
